name: Due For Viral Load
description: Patients that are due for Viral load checkup

baseCohortDefinition.name: Active patients due for viral load

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM (SELECT e.patient_id FROM encounter e WHERE e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND e.voided = 0) active_on_art WHERE patient_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM person p WHERE p.voided = 0 AND p.death_date IS NOT NULL AND p.death_date <= :endDate) AND patient_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_id FROM encounter e INNER JOIN obs t ON e.encounter_id = t.encounter_id WHERE e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND t.concept_id = 99161 AND t.value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid IN ('99430', '90210')) AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND e.voided = 0 AND t.voided = 0) AND (patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM (SELECT art_start.patient_id, MIN(art_start.value_datetime) AS art_start_date FROM obs art_start WHERE art_start.concept_id = 99161 AND art_start.value_datetime <= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AND art_start.voided = 0 GROUP BY art_start.patient_id) on_art_6m LEFT JOIN (SELECT patient_id, MAX(obs_datetime) AS last_vl_date FROM obs WHERE concept_id = 856 AND obs_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0 GROUP BY patient_id) vl ON on_art_6m.patient_id = vl.patient_id WHERE vl.last_vl_date IS NULL OR vl.last_vl_date < DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 12 MONTH)) OR patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM (SELECT e.patient_id FROM encounter e WHERE e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e.voided = 0 GROUP BY e.patient_id HAVING MAX(e.encounter_datetime) <= :endDate) all_on_art LEFT JOIN (SELECT patient_id, MAX(obs_datetime) AS last_vl_date FROM obs WHERE concept_id = 856 AND obs_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0 GROUP BY patient_id) vl ON all_on_art.patient_id = vl.patient_id INNER JOIN person p ON all_on_art.patient_id = p.person_id WHERE (vl.last_vl_date IS NULL OR vl.last_vl_date >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 12 MONTH) AND vl.last_vl_date < DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 6 MONTH)) AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birthdate, :endDate) >= 15) OR patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM (SELECT e.patient_id FROM encounter e WHERE e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e.voided = 0 GROUP BY e.patient_id HAVING MAX(e.encounter_datetime) <= :endDate) all_on_art2 LEFT JOIN (SELECT patient_id, MAX(obs_datetime) AS last_vl_date FROM obs WHERE concept_id = 856 AND obs_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0 GROUP BY patient_id) vl2 ON all_on_art2.patient_id = vl2.patient_id INNER JOIN person p2 ON all_on_art2.patient_id = p2.person_id WHERE (vl2.last_vl_date IS NULL OR vl2.last_vl_date >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AND vl2.last_vl_date < DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p2.birthdate, :endDate) < 15)

SELECT MIN(DATE(e.encounter_datetime)) FROM encounter e WHERE e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_type = (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid = '8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f') AND e.voided = 0
SELECT DATE(value_datetime) FROM obs WHERE concept_id = 99161 AND person_id = :patientId AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT DATE(obs_datetime) FROM obs WHERE concept_id = 856 AND person_id = :patientId AND obs_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT value_numeric FROM obs WHERE concept_id = 856 AND person_id = :patientId AND obs_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1) < 1000 THEN 'Suppressed' ELSE 'Not Suppressed' END
SELECT value_numeric FROM obs WHERE concept_id = 856 AND person_id = :patientId AND obs_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(DATE(e.encounter_datetime)) FROM encounter e WHERE e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND e.voided = 0
SELECT MAX(DATE(value_datetime)) FROM obs WHERE concept_id = 5096 AND person_id = :patientId AND obs_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = 'a89a8f20-1350-11df-a1f1-0024e8c6b857') AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 AND o.value_coded = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '1065') LIMIT 1) THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END
